Source-feature priority: Image 1 controls the actual visible hair, eyebrow HAIR, facial hair and clothing. Image 2 controls mascot anatomy and identity only; its bare scalp or lack of eyebrows must not erase source-visible hair. Retain every clearly visible source eyebrow as colored HAIR in its actual shape, extent and color, not a yellow ridge, socket shadow or cap shadow. Keep the source hairstyle and any visible temple/side hair and beard extent. Features actually covered or absent in the source stay covered or absent. The rounded chin meets a VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition. Refit the existing neckline and lapels around the compact head while preserving their open/closed style; do not fill an open V with a long narrow yellow funnel.
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the exact original game character portrait/card and sole source authority. Image2 is the user yellow mascot identity reference. Produce one independent full-resolution yellow mascot fusion preserving original composition and aspect ratio.
Actually viewed source-specific features: Standalone full painted rectangle. Middle-aged man in close bust turned slightly toward screen right, short grey temple hair under a tall navy cloth cap with red edging, narrow yellow zigzags, green stripe and navy folded crown with hanging tail at screen right. Dark brows, clean-shaven chin and upper lip, closed downturned mouth. Navy coat with colored shoulder stripes and deep red inner neck cloth; muted pale grey-beige painted background. Preserve the full backing, serious look and cap folds; adapt to a short broad mascot neck.
Convert the visible character anatomy to a smooth golden-yellow compact round mascot with green-ringed black eyes, retaining original hair/fur contour, brows and only actual source facial hair with exact extent, density and colour. Preserve all real accessories, headgear, clothing details, source head direction, gaze, pose, lighting and crop. Do not infer appearance from filename or biography. No human skin/nose/ears, new beard, hat, people, symbols or decorations.
Match the actual source mouth and expression: a somber downturned mouth remains visibly downturned, a small lip parting remains slightly open, and an open toothy or happy mouth remains open. Do not replace every mouth with the neutral grey reference wedge or an upward smile. Retain subtle asymmetry and brow mood.
Use one simple mascot mouth opening with the actual source curve and openness. Do not retain or add separately projecting human upper and lower lips, a cupid bow, fleshy lip rolls or lipstick-like outer rims. Visible teeth, tongue or mouth interior may remain when required by the source expression; those alone are not lip defects.
Use a compact round head with curved chin resting immediately at the source neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD transition. Fit existing garment collar and shoulder lines to the mascot, preserving original open/closed fastening. No long yellow stalk, neck roll, pinched ring, floating collar, clipping or cream neck bib. Preserve actual bare/animal clothing state; do not invent a human garment where absent.
Standalone source retains its COMPLETE original painted rectangular backdrop and all original subject/clothing through every edge, fully opaque. Only an original framed card retains that exact tilted frame, wholly opaque backing, cream overlapping note and genuine alpha outside the complete card silhouette. Keep original upper-note multirow markings in their actual position/footprint/contrast as indistinct dark strokes; never erase them into blank parchment, add extra writing or invent readable words/numbers. All original solid surfaces stay fully opaque. Keep full painterly detail and tool output resolution. One asset, no comparison board, new label, text or watermark.
Output background: the exact original was visually verified to be a COMPLETE rectangular painted portrait, with no fully transparent source pixels. Its small original alpha variation does not establish an exterior figure cutout. Preserve the entire original background colour, texture, lighting and crop to all four canvas edges. Return a fully opaque rectangular image, alpha 255 throughout the originally opaque backdrop and subject, including hair, glasses, dark clothing and corners. Do not copy an incorrect target cutout mask or partial transparency. No transparent backdrop, fog, see-through fabric, haze, halo or invented frame/note. Keep every unrelated source feature unchanged.

source_code:
"""Account one terminal network error, then continue other sources without replay."""
import copy,json,sys
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.rolling_production_queue import no_calling
from tools.production_window_gate import inspect_window
run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v19';window=run+'-window1024';key='d80f964be30aac08b650877983a69488f80152221b4644c6e6fcfb528268a427'
statep=ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json';state=read_json(statep)
assert state['status']=='running' and state['next_index']==1024 and state['completed_source_requests']==state['completed_windows']==0
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')=={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id()}
cutoff=datetime.fromisoformat(state['created_at_utc'])+timedelta(seconds=7200);assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<cutoff
no_calling(ROOT);assert inspect_window(ROOT,state['after_window'],machine_id())['ready']
failed=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings/{window}-stopped.json';failure=read_json(failed)
assert failure['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation' and failure['planned_requests']==1
resolved=[e for e in failure['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved'];invoked=[e for e in failure['events'] if e['phase']=='image_invoked']
error='image generation failed: network error: error sending request'
assert len(resolved)==len(invoked)==1 and resolved[0]['key']==invoked[0]['key']==key and resolved[0]['error']==error
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches'];item=plan[1024]
assert item['batch']==failure['batches'][0]['batch'];jobs=read_json(ROOT/item['jobs']);assert len(jobs)==1;job=jobs[0]
journalp=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/generation-requests/{key}.json';journal=read_json(journalp);attempt=journal['attempts'][-1]
assert attempt['number']==1 and attempt['status']=='failed' and attempt['error']==error+'\n' and attempt['prompt']==job['prompt']
ledgerp=ROOT/f'runtime/production-queue/dispatch/{key}-001.json';ledger=read_json(ledgerp)
assert ledger['status']=='tool_error' and ledger['actual_prompt_verified_before_call'] and not ledger.get('returned_image')
snapshot=Path(ledger['actual_request_snapshot_file']);assert read_json(snapshot)==job
assert file_sha256(snapshot)==ledger['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']==attempt['actual_request_verification']['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']
assert [file_sha256(Path(p)) for p in job['references']]==ledger['input_sha256']
assert file_sha256(ROOT/attempt['prompt_file'])==attempt['prompt_sha256']==ledger['prompt_sha256']
assert file_sha256(Path(ledger['actual_error_file']))==ledger['actual_error_sha256']
assert Path(ledger['actual_error_file']).read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()==error
assert key not in read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json')['portraits']
assert key not in read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/image-retry-queue.json')['sources']
assert any(e['phase']=='local_command_finished' and e['exit_code']==0 and 'generation_requests.py fail' in e['command'].replace('\\','/') for e in failure['events'])
auditp=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261026-v19-window1024-network-reconciliation.json';assert not auditp.exists()
completed_id=window+'-network-reconciled';completed=failed.with_name(completed_id+'-completed.json');assert not completed.exists()
receipt=copy.deepcopy(failure);receipt.update(window_id=completed_id,status='completed',completed_at_utc=utc_now(),source_stopped_receipt=failed.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),source_stopped_receipt_sha256=file_sha256(failed),result_classification='terminal_network_error_no_returned_image',new_image_calls_during_reconciliation=0,scope='Completed means only the actual terminal tool error was durably recorded. No returned PNG, art approval, content refusal or service retry. Original stopped receipt remains byte-for-byte unchanged.')
receipt['events'].append({'phase':'batch_imports_completed','batch':item['batch'],'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'terminal_error_import_only':True})
write_json(completed,receipt);assert inspect_window(ROOT,completed_id,machine_id())['ready']
updated=copy.deepcopy(state);updated.update(next_index=1025,after_window=completed_id,completed_windows=1,completed_source_requests=1,updated_at_utc=utc_now(),last_local_reconciliation=auditp.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
spec={'run_id':run,'machine_id':machine_id(),'owner_created_at_utc':state['created_at_utc'],'original_deadline_utc':cutoff.isoformat(),'original_max_calls':64,'completed_calls_before_continuation':1,'original_max_preview_bytes':6553600,'previous_preview_upper_bound_bytes':0,'start_index':1025,'after_window':completed_id,'helper_sources':'docs/handoffs/2026-10-26-low-v19-helper-sources.json','scope':'Same actual owner and fixed cutoff; continue unrelated already prepared sources. The failed source is not replayed or newly prepared.'}
specp=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-v19-network-continuation-spec-20261026.json';assert not specp.exists();write_json(specp,spec)
write_json(auditp,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'actual_failed_builtin_cell':'1323 completed with terminal network error','original_owner_state':state,'original_owner_state_sha256':file_sha256(statep),'source_stopped_receipt':failed.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'source_stopped_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(failed),'actual_dispatch':ledger,'actual_dispatch_sha256':file_sha256(ledgerp),'actual_full_job':job,'actual_attempt':attempt,'actual_error':error,'reconciled_receipt':completed.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'reconciled_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(completed),'continuation_spec':spec,'continuation_spec_sha256':file_sha256(specp),'owner_state_after':updated,'new_image_calls':0,'new_PNGs':0,'service_refusal_or_cooldown_changes':0,'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'status':'terminal_error_accounted_once_same_owner_continuation_ready'})
write_json(statep,updated)
print(json.dumps({'actual_calls_accounted':1,'returned_PNGs':0,'next_index':1025,'original_cutoff_unchanged':cutoff.isoformat(),'audit':auditp.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}),flush=True)
